allQuestions.r1.text: I like practical work with my hands, such as repairing, building, or working with machines
allQuestions.i1.text: I like analyzing problems, researching, and understanding how things work
allQuestions.a1.text: I like being creative, making new things, and expressing myself artistically
allQuestions.s1.text: I enjoy helping, teaching, or supporting other people
allQuestions.e1.text: I like leading, influencing others, selling, or running projects
allQuestions.c1.text: I like organizing, structuring, and working with numbers or details
allQuestions.bf_o1.text: I am curious about new ideas and like trying new ways of doing things
allQuestions.bf_o2.text: I appreciate art, creativity, and thinking in new ways
allQuestions.bf_c1.text: I am careful, organized, and finish what I start
allQuestions.bf_c2.text: I plan my work well and meet deadlines
allQuestions.bf_e1.text: I am outgoing, talkative, and enjoy social situations
allQuestions.bf_e2.text: I get energy from being with other people
allQuestions.bf_a1.text: I care about other people and I am helpful
allQuestions.bf_a2.text: I work well with others and try to avoid conflict
allQuestions.bf_n1.text: I handle stress and pressure well
allQuestions.bf_n2.text: My mood is stable, and I recover quickly from setbacks
allQuestions.si1.text: I am interested in technology, mechanics, and understanding how things work
allQuestions.si2.text: I am interested in natural science, biology, chemistry, and research
allQuestions.si3.text: I am interested in art, culture, design, and creative work
allQuestions.si4.text: I am interested in helping and supporting people in difficult situations
allQuestions.si5.text: I am interested in business, sales, and running my own projects
allQuestions.si6.text: I am interested in administration, office work, and organization
allQuestions.si7.text: I am interested in outdoor work and working in nature
allQuestions.si8.text: I am interested in leading, organizing, and managing projects
allQuestions.si9.text: I am interested in computers, IT, programming, and digital systems
allQuestions.si10.text: I am interested in teaching, instructing, and explaining things to others
allQuestions.icf_cog.text: I find it easy to remember things, plan my work, and solve problems
allQuestions.icf_com.text: I can express myself clearly, understand social cues, and work together with others
allQuestions.icf_con.text: I can focus on tasks for a long time and ignore distractions
allQuestions.icf_mot_grov.text: I can move freely, stand, walk, and handle physical work tasks
allQuestions.icf_mot_fin.text: I have steady hands and can do precision work that requires accuracy
allQuestions.icf_sen.text: I handle sound, light, and other sensory input well without becoming overwhelmed
allQuestions.icf_en_fys.text: I have the energy to be physically active during the workday
allQuestions.icf_en_men.text: I have the energy to think, learn, and handle mentally demanding tasks
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.name: Cognitive function
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.adaptations.0: Use checklists and reminders for daily tasks
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.adaptations.1: Break complex tasks into smaller, manageable steps
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.adaptations.2: Use digital tools such as calendars and note-taking apps
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.adaptations.3: Ask for written instructions instead of spoken ones
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.adaptations.4: Create clear routines and fixed structures
icfAdaptations.kognitiv.adaptations.5: Use memory aids, such as putting notes in places you will see them
icfAdaptations.kommunikation.name: Communication
icfAdaptations.kommunikation.adaptations: Ask for clear instructions in writing
Use communication aids if you need them
Ask for regular check-ins with your manager
Work in a smaller team or with a mentor
Ask for extra time to express yourself
icfAdaptations.koncentration.name: Concentration and attention
icfAdaptations.koncentration.adaptations: Work in a quiet place with fewer distractions
Use techniques such as the Pomodoro method
Ask for a flexible place to work
Use focus apps or website blockers
icfAdaptations.motorik.name: Motor skills and movement
icfAdaptations.motorik.description: Gross motor skills, fine motor skills, and mobility
icfAdaptations.motorik.adaptations.1: Use aids if you need them
icfAdaptations.motorik.adaptations.2: Choose work with fewer physical demands
icfAdaptations.motorik.adaptations.3: Ask for help with heavy lifting
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.name: Sensory processing
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.description: Handling sensory input such as sound, light, and smell
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.adaptations.0: Use ear protection or noise-cancelling headphones
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.adaptations.1: Adjust the lighting at your workplace
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.adaptations.2: Work in a place with controlled sensory input
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.adaptations.3: Take breaks to recover from sensory strain
icfAdaptations.sensorisk.adaptations.5: Ask for a workplace with a quiet, private space
icfAdaptations.energi.name: Energy level and stamina
icfAdaptations.energi.adaptations.0: Work part-time or with flexible hours
icfAdaptations.energi.adaptations.1: Have the option of short rest breaks
icfAdaptations.energi.adaptations.2: Adjust tasks to match your energy level
icfAdaptations.energi.adaptations.3: Work from home part of the week
icfAdaptations.energi.adaptations.5: Ask for understanding about your energy levels changing
